headline: Violent Clashes Erupt In Marban Hollow As Linn Of Mercy Battles Persist
war_summary: Combat shifted sharply over the past three hours as Marban Hollow erupted into rapid back-and-forth fighting, logging eleven base transitions at Checkpoint Bua within the latest two-hour interval. Linn of Mercy remains embroiled in severe clashes, recording ten additional base shifts across Rotdust and Outwich Ranch alongside climbing casualty tolls. Nevish Line also saw renewed territorial turnover with six base events and punishing losses exceeding fifteen hundred combined dead in two hours. Meanwhile, Weathered Expanse logged four fresh shifts, leaving three positions in neutral ruins amid steady frontline pressure. In Callahan's Passage and Mooring County, where earlier flare-ups drove heavy movement, base exchanges have slowed, though severe attritional fighting persists in Callahan's Passage with more than thirteen hundred casualties over the past two hours. Stonecradle and the southern interior remain dormant with no strategic movement reported.
